'''Earth Strike''' is an [[Earth spells|earth]]-based [[Strike spells|strike spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 9 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Earth Strike starts out with a base maximum hit of 6. Once the player has the Magic level required to cast [[Fire Strike]], Earth Strike's base maximum hit is increased to match.

As with all combat spells, Earth Strike's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an earth-based spell, Earth Strike's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to earth]].

== Notable uses ==

* As a strike spell, Earth Strike is one of the only spells that can be used to damage [[Salarin the twisted]]. When used this way, its damage is scaled up to match that of [[Earth Bolt]].
